Put your to-do list on the home screen. Tap a task on the widget to check it off.
Keep the widget up to date

Some phones stop apps that run in the background. When that happens to DeskDo, the home-screen widget freezes: it keeps showing old tasks and ignores taps until you open the app again. These settings prevent that. You only need to do this once.
Find DeskDo in the list and switch it on.
Allow background activity, then also set Xiaomi\'s Battery saver to “No restrictions”.
Allow DeskDo to run in the background. Without this, Android delays the widget\'s refresh for apps you rarely open.
Swiping DeskDo out of recent apps stops it. To protect it: open recent apps, long-press DeskDo and tap the lock. In App info, also turn off “Pause app activity if unused”.
On some phones, swiping DeskDo out of recent apps stops it. In App info, also turn off “Pause app activity if unused”.
